changelog: Shotgun: the chart editor showed only read tracking, because the chart tables (r_tables/: taxonomy per rank, heatmaps, alpha diversity, rarefaction…) were never built for shotgun runs — viz_pipeline.R ran after DADA2, ITS, COX1 and PacBio only (Emu runs it itself). Shotgun results are in Emu's layout, which the script already reads; it now runs after every shotgun run. Checked on a real run on nextapp before release. Older shotgun runs: re-analyse, or run viz_pipeline.R on the folder once. Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: setup_shotgun.sh --amr put the AMRFinderPlus 4.2 database in the base conda env's share folder (amrfinder -u follows $CONDA_PREFIX, which is base when the script runs from (base)), so the shotgun pipeline did not find it and kept using the 2024 database. The database now goes into envs/ngamp-amr. No backend restart needed.
